name: anime-cel

styleBlock.medium: 2D anime production still: hand-painted digital background art combined with cel-shaded characters and props, clean finished-frame look.
styleBlock.lines: Bold, clean, uniform-weight dark outlines on characters and foreground objects; thinner, color-tinted lines on distant elements; crisp, confident strokes with no sketchiness.

palette.role: deep navy, outlines and night shadows
dusk blue, shadow side of forms
warm peach, skin and lit surfaces

styleBlock.light: Stylized light defined by shape rather than falloff: a flat key light with a clearly drawn light/shadow boundary, occasional hard rim highlights, and light sources rendered as a soft bloom over flat color.
styleBlock.texture: Clean, flat color fills with almost no grain; background paintings may carry very light brush texture; no photographic noise.
styleBlock.contrast: Medium-high contrast between lit and shadow tones; saturated accents against calmer mid-tones.
styleBlock.shading: Cel shading: one hard-edged shadow tone per surface (occasionally a second, darker tone), no gradients on characters, highlights drawn as sharp shapes.

motionHints: rain streaks falling steadily past the window
hair and clothing edges swaying slightly
steam rising in simple stylized wisps
city lights or stars twinkling in the distance
curtain edge moving slightly in a breeze

music.aesthetic: late night city apartment, nostalgic, rain on glass
